data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016 the Syndicate released GBP 95.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2015: GBP 95.7m), arising predominantly from the Energy and Treaty Divisions (2015: primarily from the Energy, Casualty and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2016.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,609.0m. During 2016 the Syndicate reported a release on prior period technical reserves of GBP 95.7m, arising predominantly in the Energy and Treaty divisions and attributed to favourable claims development on losses during 2016. The release equates to around a 5.95% reduction of opening gross claims outstanding. Notable 2016 loss events referenced include the Fort McMurray wildfire, North Canterbury and Esmeraldas earthquakes and other market catastrophes; individual event net exposures are disclosed in the Technical Reserves note.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year movement source used is the narrative 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a release of GBP 95.7m of technical reserves. The note describes 'technical reserves' (may include other technical items) and does not explicitly label the figure as 'gross claims outstanding' - the figure is therefore taken as the best available measure of prior-year reserve movement but may include components beyond gross claims outstanding. A detailed gross-only PYD figure was not explicitly provided in a single labelled gross 'prior year movement' cell; a gross claims development triangle exists but was not used to compute a separate gross PYD here. Named event amounts are reported as given in the Technical Reserves note (some figures are net of reinsurance and/or after reinstatement premiums).
